description.en: Beyond the mountain trails, a sheltered retreat overlooks Crane Peak. It feels quiet enough for a lesson. Whether the lesson stays quiet is another matter.
description.zh-CN: 越过山路，一处隐蔽的居所俯瞰着鹤峰。这里安静得适合上课。至于这堂课能不能一直安静下去，就难说了。

特想念阿九，回来找她来了.en: Check on Cleopatra's training with Horus.
特想念阿九，回来找她来了.zh-CN: 和荷鲁斯一起看看克娄巴特拉的修习进展。

获得铁剑令，习得铁剑门绝学剑法.en: Received the Iron Sword Token and Open Sky Sword Manual.
获得铁剑令，习得铁剑门绝学剑法.zh-CN: 获得铁剑令牌与长空剑术手册。

text.en: Imhotep? How is Cleopatra?
text.zh-CN: 伊姆霍特普？克娄巴特拉怎么样了？

text.en: Ask her yourself. Try not to look so surprised.
text.zh-CN: 你自己问她吧。尽量别太惊讶。

text.en: Horus. You took your time.
text.zh-CN: 荷鲁斯。你可让我等了不短的时间。

text.en: You look ready to conquer something.
text.zh-CN: 看起来，你已经准备好征服点什么了。

text.en: She usually is.
text.zh-CN: 她一向如此。

text.en: First, I'd settle for getting off this mountain.
text.zh-CN: 眼下，能先下山，我就很满意了。

text.en: An expedition with a sensible goal. That's new.
text.zh-CN: 目标这么实际的远行，还真少见。

text.en: Take care of each other. Wait—who's there?
text.zh-CN: 你们互相照顾。等等——谁在那儿？

text.en: Imhotep. Still playing teacher?
text.zh-CN: 伊姆霍特普。还在当你的老师？

text.en: Set. What do you want?
text.zh-CN: 赛特。你想干什么？

text.en: Something you lost.
text.zh-CN: 找回一样你丢掉的东西。

text.en: (Set raises a small iron sword, stamped with the order's seal.)
text.zh-CN: （赛特举起一柄小铁剑，上面铸着传承的印记。）

text.en: The Iron Sword Token. After all this time.
text.zh-CN: 铁剑令牌。隔了这么久，竟然又见到了。

text.en: You swore to honor its bearer. Kneel.
text.zh-CN: 你发过誓，要尊重持有它的人。跪下。

text.en: (Imhotep lowers his head before the old seal.)
text.zh-CN: （伊姆霍特普向古老的印记低下头。）

text.en: There. Much better. Now stay down.
text.zh-CN: 这就对了。现在，别起来了。

text.en: That's enough.
text.zh-CN: 够了。

text.en: All of you against me. Is that how your honorable school teaches courage?
text.zh-CN: 你们一群人对付我一个。你们这体面的传承，就是这样教人勇气的？

text.en: You mistook respect for surrender.
text.zh-CN: 你把尊重，当成了投降。

text.en: (Set swallows a black pellet and draws a ragged breath.)
text.zh-CN: （赛特吞下一颗黑色药丸，急促地吸了一口气。）

text.en: Careful. That wasn't a snack.
text.zh-CN: 当心。那可不是点心。

text.en: (His next breath comes out as a growl. He raises his sword.)
text.zh-CN: （他的下一口气变成了低吼，手中的剑再次举起。）

text.en: What—get it off me!
text.zh-CN: 什么——快把它弄走！

text.en: (A small golden serpent darts from the rocks and bites Set. He stiffens, then collapses.)
text.zh-CN: （一条小金蛇从石缝中窜出，咬住赛特。他浑身一僵，随后倒了下去。）

text.en: We learned under the same teacher. Our teacher valued skill. Set valued obedience.
text.zh-CN: 我们曾在同一位老师门下学习。老师看重本领，赛特却只想让人服从。

text.en: Our teacher lost that token on a journey. Set spent years hunting for it, and never wondered what it was meant to protect.
text.zh-CN: 老师在一次远行中遗失了令牌。赛特花了多年寻找，却从没想过，这传承究竟该守护什么。

text.en: He can't use it against you now.
text.zh-CN: 现在，他再也不能拿它对付你了。

text.en: The token is yours, Cleopatra. Let it remind you what authority is for.
text.zh-CN: 令牌归你了，克娄巴特拉。让它提醒你，权威该用来做什么。

text.en: You trust me with it?
text.zh-CN: 你放心把它交给我？

text.en: You know the difference between leading and being obeyed. Take the token and this Open Sky Sword Manual. It's time I saw more of the world.
text.zh-CN: 你知道，带领别人和让别人服从，并不一样。拿好令牌和这本长空剑术手册，我也该多出去看看了。

text.en: We'll put your teaching to good use.
text.zh-CN: 我们会把你教的本领用在正地方。

text.en: See that you do. I'd hate to have to climb back up here.
text.zh-CN: 说到做到。我可不想再爬回来检查。
